title: EvaluatorInput
description: Runtime inputs for the Graphics Complexity evaluator.

items.description: Local file path or http(s) URL to one graphic. Supported: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP (detected by file signature, not by extension).

graphics.description: One entry per graphic in scope, in the order they should be considered.

figure_labels.description: Optional comma-separated labels matching the order of `graphics` (e.g. 'Figure 1, Figure 2'). If omitted, graphics are auto-labeled 'Image 1', 'Image 2', etc.
